hero.headline: Decks, pergolas and renovations across the Shoalhaven, built to a high standard.
hero.subhead: Decks and pergolas, kitchen and bathroom renovations, home improvements and repairs from Kiama to Ulladulla. Send through the job and get a clear written quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Falzon Carpentry assistant. Got a deck, pergola, reno or repair in mind? Tell me a bit about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time with Declan.

about.headline: You picture it. We build it properly.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a carpenter: a clear price before work starts, someone who explains the process as they go, and workmanship that still looks right years later. Every job is run that way, from a drawer repair to a full renovation.

cards.title: Outdoor spaces
cards.body: Decks and pergolas built for the coast, ready for summer on the South Coast.

cards.title: Rooms ready for a reno
cards.body: Kitchen and bathroom renovations with the process explained at every step.

cards.title: Jobs around the house
cards.body: Custom home improvements, maintenance and repairs, big or small.

about.closing: Not sure where to start? Send a few photos and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Finding a good chippy on the South Coast shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: You ring around and wait weeks for anyone to come and quote.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough number that keeps growing once the job starts.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: The deck that was meant to be done for summer still isn't finished.

points.title: Sloppy finishing
points.body: Uneven boards, gaps in the trim and corners cut where you can see them.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a tradie just to get a clear quote.

services.title: Decks & pergolas
services.body: New decks and pergolas built to a high standard, designed around how you'll use the space.

services.title: Renovations & home improvements
services.body: Kitchen and bathroom renovations and custom improvements, with each step explained.

services.title: Maintenance & repairs
services.body: Repairs and maintenance around the house, from doors and shelves to drawers and trim.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your quote
steps.body: Send a few details and photos with the form or give Declan a ring.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We have a look, talk through the options and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Quality work
steps.body: The process explained as we go, with the site kept tidy.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished job with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to build it right.

themes.title: Quality workmanship
themes.body: High-quality carpentry with real attention to detail.

themes.title: Written quotes
themes.body: Scope and price in writing, so you know what you're paying for.

themes.title: Explained every step
themes.body: You understand the process, from the first visit to the finish.

themes.title: Big or small
themes.body: Full renovations and quick repairs get the same care.

realReviews.author: Cass Musso
realReviews.text: Extremely professional business, Declan did multiple renovations in my home including my bathroom and kitchen and did a great job. Helped me understand the process each step of the way and I was so pleased with the end result. Highly recommend this service

realReviews.author: Calum Harvie-McKay
realReviews.text: Got a shelf and draw repair done quick and easy no hassles. Would definitely use next time

realReviews.author: Simon Booth
realReviews.text: Exceptional quality of workmanship, no complaints

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your deck, reno or repair?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
